eventDetail.scope: ATMAE 2027 focuses on advanced technologies in mechanical, automotive and energy engineering, bringing together researchers and industry experts to discuss emerging solutions in smart manufacturing, green mobility and sustainable energy systems. The conference highlights artificial intelligence, digital twins, intelligent control, automation, energy efficiency and innovative engineering approaches supporting sustainable industrial development.
